scope: r490 same r478 10sim-second moving lead; r481/r482/r486 approved Python changes only; original acceptance retained

launch.entry_r0: demo.launch.py (same arguments as the existing validator's local_pursuit path, g1_follow_enabled unset=false)
launch.speed_profile_note: 실제 등속/정지 앞차 비교에서 사용한 1.5 m/s. 단독 10 km/h 설정은 사용하지 않는다.
launch.temporary_traffic_light_trigger: 공식 2×5 실제 픽셀 출발. 시험 초록은 출발 신호 아님.

vehicle_and_sensor_unchanged: 현재 CAD C1 X75.4/Z134.6mm·새 지주·전방배선6mm·마스크 움직임3mm 여유; 축거128mm·윤거123.9mm·타이어 폭26.1mm·물리 차체199.7mm/X+3.65mm·대칭 계획207mm; CAD 서보 -23.6~+23.4deg·내륜30deg/외륜23.3deg; 질량/접지는 기존 근사, B0390축198.363mm. 단일모터28count·2.5*81/17·65mm 유지.

actor.visible_section: 상대 높이220mm는 팀 차량과 비슷한 높이의 시험 가정. C1 Z134.6mm가 가로지르며 더 낮은 상대를 대신 검증하지 않는다.
actor.physics: static model moved by evaluator set_pose (teleport); collision geometry and contact sensor follow the commanded pose (g1b_contact_probe_v1). Infinite-mass blocker, not a vehicle dynamics model.
actor.start_center_gap_note: same as the G1-a synthetic suite; ego body front to actor rear is 1.40 m

seed_note: Gazebo has no injected noise here; a seed fixes a deterministic actor start offset along the centerline so that scan/command phase differs between repetitions.
schedule_anchor: sim time at which the evaluator first observes applied=green on /sim/traffic_light/state (evaluator only; the controller detects green from its own camera)

cases.name: straight_moving_lead
cases.expected: 진입한 자차가 지속 속도 차를 잃는 경우. 이동차가 여전히 앞인지, 관측한 경로로 뒤에 합류해 계속 가는지를 구분.

straight_section_check: 직선/첫코너 기존 검사는 불변. full_course만 전체 등록 앞차 경로를1cm마다 도로/벽 대조하고 1.2랩 이내로 제한.

acceptance.minimum_body_gap_basis: G1-a pre-registered minimum body gap (config/tests/g1_follow_v1.json); applied to BOTH the sampled gap and the conservative swept lower bound
acceptance.swept_note: lower bound assumes rigid planar motion with monotonic yaw between ego pose samples and path curvature <= tan(0.37)/0.135 = 2.9 /m
acceptance.outside_road_basis: 옛 차체전체 도로 판정은 원시로 보존하며 명시 full_course의 바퀴 중심 최대2개와 별도 조밀 노면을 적용.

stopped_center.basis: HOLD at G1 swept clearance <= 0.20 m (+ about 0.06-0.13 m padding) predicts a 0.2-0.45 m body gap (synthetic 0.405 m). 0.70 m is half of the 1.40 m initial gap: it separates an approach-and-hold from a stall near the start. 3.0 s of continuous zero speed within a 10 s window.

slow_lead.basis: lead travels 4.2 m; following must not degenerate into a permanent stall. 2.5 s reuses the G1-a restart limit. Final gap must be below the 1.40 m start gap.

acceptance.stationary_definition: model ground speed < 0.01 m/s, /drive/safe speed == 0 and (G1) behavior HOLD; R0 has no behavior field

harness.basis: G0 command interval limit; 0.035 m = about 0.1 s of 0.35 m/s lag. A harness failure invalidates the run instead of counting as a controller result.

acceptance.threshold_status: pre-registered before execution; not measured real vehicle guarantees. Do not relax after results; a change needs a new config version and a rerun.

moving_stop_restart.basis: 선정 구성의 정지·재개·코너 출구 기준. 정지 시작·끝만 이 각본의 3–8초에 맞춘다.

cut_in.basis: 기존 앞차 추종 기준. 상대는 코너 1 m 전에 멈춘다.

straight_moving_lead.basis: lead travels 4.2 m; following must not degenerate into a permanent stall. 2.5 s reuses the G1-a restart limit. Final gap must be below the 1.40 m start gap.

persistent_block.basis: 옛 HOLD 판정 원본. 사용자 결정의 우회는 goal_eval.py에서 본다.

solo_course_lap.basis: 80초 상대64m 경로 감사. 자차1랩·원 지속/간격/노면/충돌/STOP 기준 유지.

merge_acceptance.basis: 0.55 m/s·최대 곡률 약 1.26/m의 yaw rate 0.69 rad/s × 기존 0.11 s 지연 + 0.005 rad. 상대 각본 실행 확인 전용.

changes_from_r6: current ego vehicle and sensor configuration
actor height 0.12 to0.22m; recessed_sides visuals; box collision unchanged in XY
actor command_hz50 to100 as r475 actor template

first_corner_basis: artifacts/validation/2026-11-07/traffic_course_migration_v1/geometry_probe.json: 새 중심선 s=0 직선 끝(첫 직각 꼭짓점). 평가 전용, 제어 입력 아님
